generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential from 1; never NULL; unique per table; generated PKs start above compact maxima.
generic_sampling_rules.smallint_unsigned: Uniform integer in [1, 32767]; never NULL for NOT NULL columns.
generic_sampling_rules.tinyint_unsigned: Uniform integer in [1, 255]; never NULL for NOT NULL columns.
generic_sampling_rules.mediumint_unsigned: Uniform integer in [1, 8388607]; never NULL for NOT NULL columns.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_short: Random uppercase word from a 200-word pool, length 3-20; near-variants (case, trailing space) for equality/LIKE targets.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_long: Random sentence 20-120 chars from a template pool.
generic_sampling_rules.text: Random sentence 40-200 chars; occasional near-duplicate of another row's text.
generic_sampling_rules.decimal_money: Uniform in [0.00, 99.99] rounded to 2 decimals; boundary values at listed literals plus one step (0.01) on each side, mixed with uniform draws (boundary probability 0.2).
generic_sampling_rules.decimal_rate: Uniform in [0.00, 9.99] rounded to 2 decimals; boundary values at listed literals plus one step (0.01) on each side, mixed with uniform draws (boundary probability 0.2).
generic_sampling_rules.datetime: Uniform timestamp in [2005-05-24 00:00:00, 2006-02-15 23:59:59], format %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S; duplicates allowed on DISTINCT-target columns.
generic_sampling_rules.timestamp: Constant 2006-02-15 04:00:00 unless a column is a DISTINCT target; then vary by seconds.
generic_sampling_rules.enum_special_features: Random subset of ('Trailers','Commentaries','Deleted Scenes','Behind the Scenes') joined by comma, or NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column, use the compact database's NULL share; if that share is 0.0, plant at least one NULL row per instance (share >= 1/n) unless the spec overrides the share; NOT NULL and primary-key columns never get NULL; clamp planted NULLs to at most n-1 so at least one non-NULL row remains unless an explicit 100%-NULL exception is documented.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_values: Text columns draw fresh values with 80% probability, reuse an existing value with 20% to create duplicates/ties.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_share: For columns marked duplicates_for_distinct, with probability duplicate_share reuse a previously drawn value; applies to NumberSampler, WordSampler, StringSampler and DateSampler.
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_join_rows: For each parent/child FK pair marked unmatched_join_rows, after generating child FKs, remove all children of at least one chosen parent row so that parent has no children; child FK columns are never NULL. Identify removed child rows by full primary-key tuple (not pk_cols[0]); remove or re-point all transitive dependents in dependency order before the final FK-repair pass; a final FK-repair pass re-validates the whole chain.
generic_sampling_rules.ties_for_order_limit: For each column marked ties_for_order_limit, explicitly assign at least two child rows to the same parent (the one with the highest count) so that ordering by COUNT(*) DESC has a tie at rank 1; only existing parent keys are used; the target is mapped to the child FK column that produces the COUNT(*) grouping.
generic_sampling_rules.aggregate_boundary: For each column marked aggregate_boundary, explicitly construct child counts per parent to hit the listed target values (e.g., 2, 3, 4, 29, 30, 31) for the relevant join; only existing parent keys are used and no parent PK is mutated; size the child table to at least sum(targets); construct deterministically on distinct parents; apply after FK repair or make FK repair preserve already-valid values; assert realized per-parent counts include the target values.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: For each column marked group_sizes, explicitly assign distinct values to form one group of size 1, one of size 2 and one of size >= 3 among the column's values; for FK columns choose distinct existing parent keys; verify the resulting group-size multiset contains 1, 2 and >=3. Never rewrite primary-key columns; for FK columns only reuse values that exist in the parent table.
generic_sampling_rules.comparison_boundary: For each column marked comparison_boundary, explicitly assign at least one child row whose FK equals a parent key and one whose FK is one step from a parent key in the parent's key ordering (skip the one-step value if no such parent exists); never use arithmetic p+/-1 that may not exist.
generic_sampling_rules.fk_repair: After all constructions, run a final FK-repair pass: every child FK value must reference an existing parent key; if not, re-point to an existing parent key or drop the row. Enable foreign_keys=ON (or run an explicit FK validation query) and treat any FK violation as a unit failure. Iterate over flattened table names only; never let repair mutate values deliberately set by pattern constructors; run repair before pattern construction or make constructors FK-safe by construction.
